decisions.reason: The position requires new granite treads and risers to be manufactured, supplied, and installed as a set.

items.material_name: Straight-flight dark grey sawn-rough granite tread and riser set, R11, 148 cm long, 4 cm treads and 3 cm risers
items.description: Chamfered edges, approximately 16.5 cm rise, 28 cm going, and 2 cm tread nosing.

decisions.reason: This surcharge specifies a bush-hammered finish on the new treads.

items.material_name: Bush-hammered finish upgrade for stair treads
items.description: Applies to the treads only, not the risers.

decisions.reason: This surcharge specifies a flamed finish on the new treads.

items.material_name: Flamed finish upgrade for stair treads
items.description: Applies to the treads only, not the risers.

decisions.reason: The position calls for new stair skirting to match the stair finish.

items.material_name: Sawn-rough notched stair skirting, approximately 8 cm high by 1 cm thick
items.description: Matches the stair finish and is notched around the 2 cm nosing on both sides.

decisions.reason: The position requires new levelling mortar beneath the granite paving.

items.material_name: Semi-dry levelling mortar for granite paving, approximately 60 mm compacted thickness
items.description: Compatible with the granite bedding mortar and applied over the reinforced-concrete entrance landing.

decisions.reason: The position explicitly requires new granite flooring to be manufactured, supplied, and laid.

items.material_name: Dark grey sawn-rough granite strip flooring, R11, approximately 3 cm thick
items.description: Granite slabs laid in strips on a thick mortar bed, including cuts and grouting.

decisions.reason: This surcharge specifies a bush-hammered finish on the new flooring.

items.description: Bush-hammered finish for the flooring specified in the base position.

decisions.reason: This surcharge specifies a flamed finish on the new flooring.

items.description: Flamed finish for the flooring specified in the base position.

decisions.reason: The position calls for new perimeter skirting to match the entrance landing flooring.

items.material_name: Sawn-rough entrance landing perimeter skirting, approximately 8 cm high by 1 cm thick
items.description: Matches the flooring and is thin-bed laid with permanently elastic joints.

decisions.reason: Only the recess is formed; the entrance mat grate is supplied by others.
The grate is supplied by others, but the contractor supplies new levelling mortar as part of the recess and installation add-on.

items.material_name: Entrance mat grate recess and installation add-on with levelling mortar, approximately 1500 × 800 mm, 25 mm frame height
items.description: Includes levelling mortar and laying the base-position flooring around the grate supplied by others.

decisions.reason: The position explicitly requires new granite wall coping to be manufactured, supplied, and installed.

items.material_name: Dark grey sawn-rough granite wall coping, approximately 46 cm wide by 4 cm thick, 250 and 312.5 cm lengths
items.description: Single-slope coping with approximately 20 mm overhangs on both sides, underside drip edges, and 90° corner mitres.

decisions.reason: This surcharge specifies a bush-hammered finish on the new wall coping.

items.material_name: Bush-hammered finish upgrade for wall coping
items.description: Bush-hammered finish for the wall coping specified in the base position.

decisions.reason: This surcharge specifies a flamed finish on the new wall coping.

items.material_name: Flamed finish upgrade for wall coping
items.description: Flamed finish for the wall coping specified in the base position.

decisions.reason: The position requires a new protective impregnating sealer to be applied after cleaning.

items.material_name: Non-film-forming oil- and water-repellent granite impregnating sealer
items.description: Penetrating protection for granite stairs, the entrance landing, and wall coping.

decisions.reason: The position specifies new permanently elastic joint sealant for natural stone.

items.material_name: One-component neutral alkoxy-cure natural stone silicone joint sealant, 20% movement capacity
items.description: Weather- and UV-resistant sealant with fungal and mould resistance; joint preparation and backing included.
